name: Trinidad and Tobago
famous_for: Trinidad Carnival (greatest street party on Earth), birthplace of Steelpan drums, Calypso & Soca music, and Pitch Lake.
tourists: Over 400,000 visitors; famous for Carnival masquerade parades, Pigeon Point in Tobago, and Caroni Bird Sanctuary scarlet ibises.
must_know: The steelpan drum, crafted from 55-gallon oil drums, is the only acoustic musical instrument invented in the 20th century.
fun_fact: Pitch Lake in Trinidad is the largest natural asphalt deposit in the world, supplying tar for famous roads including London's Pall Mall.
